body:
SCROLL DOWN TO BOTTOM OF THE PAGE


Pictures: http://imgur.com/a/yBHZu (out of order)
YML: http://pastebin.com/zGdKpQct (biggest yml i have ever made. Expect some issues) if someone wants to look through this and fix some issues I had post the line number and what is wrong and how I should fix
http://maps.avicus.net/Storage/Nebula/FloralParadise/map.yml
Updated YML ^^^^^^^^^^


Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/s7xm34m9zud59vr/Seth11.rar

Maker: SacredFlameLava
Contributors: Hacktivism
Server Provider: alexanderjoe10


Purpose of Map: Create a "sub-gamemode" for DTM
What the Map is: This map is different from every map. You obtain items and gear from breaking Flowers. You can get different items from each

Reason Why it has a large void gap: To make players go over to enemy side slower when everyone is trying to gear up (get items from flowers)
Work as a team

Monument Count: 5 each side
2 double monuments on each side
(BottomLeft/Right and TopLeft/Right with two each side) 
1 monument in the center of the farm 


Loadout:
16 Bone Meal
Full Leather
Stone Sword
Bow
16 Arrows
Wooden Pickaxe
64 Steak
2 Golden Apples
1 Diamond Hoe
8 Oak Logs

Other Spawning Items:
16 Carrots
16 Potatoes
16 Seeds
8 Melon Seeds
8 Pumpkin Seeds
2 Water Buckets

Flower Items:
Fern = 1 Power 1 Bow
Peony = 16 Bone Meal
Carrots = 2 Iron Ingots
Wheat = 3 Iron Ingots
Potatoes = 2 Iron Ingots
Melon = 5 Iron
Pumpkin = diamond pickaxe
Poppy = Diamond Pickaxe
Dandelion = 1 Diamond Pickaxe
Oxeye Daisy = Iron Sword
Blue Orchid = 2 Diamond Blcoks
Lilac = 1 Diamond Block
Large Fern = Power 2 Bow
Grass = 1 Enchantment Bottle
Double Grass = 5 Enchantment Bottles (Picture shows 8 bone meal but its wrong)
Sunflower = 32 Oak Logs
Azure Bluet = 32 Arrows
Allium = 1 Iron Axe
White Tulip = 16 White Wool
Orange Tulip = 16 Orange Wool
Pink Tulip = 16 Pink Wool
Rose Bush = 64 Oak Logs


http://maps.avicus.net/Storage/Nebula/FloralParadise/map.yml
